As a Warehouse Operator at Samsung SDS in Tilburg, you play a key role in ensuring a smooth and efficient logistics process. You will join a supportive and collaborative team where communication, flexibility, and teamwork are highly valued.

In this all-round position, you will work across multiple warehouse departments and, when required, at different Samsung SDS locations in Tilburg.  
Your responsibilities may include physically active tasks such as order picking, packing, and preparing shipments, as well as administrative duties like inspecting incoming goods, managing inventory, and processing data in warehouse management systems. This variety allows you to develop a broad range of skills while keeping your work challenging and engaging.

Flexibility is an important part of the role. You will primarily work in a two-shift schedule (morning and evening shifts), but during peak periods you may also be required to work night shifts and occasional Saturdays. 

Working hours range from 20 to 37.5 hours per week, offering flexibility while supporting the operational needs of the business.

Ready to become part of a global organization and contribute to efficient warehouse operations? We'd love to hear from you!

You enjoy staying active and thrive in an international working environment. You are reliable, flexible, and enjoy working as part of a team. You're comfortable adapting to different tasks, departments, and warehouse locations.

Requirements:

- You have your own transportation to travel to Tilburg.
- You have a good command of the English language.
- You are available to work full-time.
- You are physically fit and able to perform warehouse activities.
- You are flexible and willing to work in a three-shift schedule, including evening shifts, night shifts when required, and occasional Saturdays.
- You are a team player with a proactive attitude.
- You are willing to work across multiple departments and warehouse locations.

jobs.occupation: Order Picker at AS Watson in Heteren (Arnhem) (113871003)
jobs.description:
As an order picker at AS Watson in Heteren, you’re always on the move. You collect products using a voice pick system: your headset tells you where to go, you grab the right product, and confirm it. You walk a lot, lift small and large packages, and make sure everything ends up in the right place. You work in a 2- or 3-shift system, depending on your preference. This means sometimes you start early, sometimes later, but you always have time for yourself. In this role as warehouse worker or logistics employee, you really make an impact: thanks to you, thousands of people can shop daily at Kruidvat, Trekpleister, and ICI Paris XL.

- You speak Dutch or English
- You can handle physical work
- You’re available to work at least one Saturday every four weeks
- You choose either a 2- or 3-shift system
- You live a maximum of 30 km from Heteren

Looking for an active part-time job in the evening?

As a Logistics Associate at DHL, you will work together with your colleagues to ensure a smooth sorting process. You will process packages so they can reach their destination on time.

You can start as a Loader, where you place packages onto the conveyor belt, or as an Unloader, where you remove sorted packages from the conveyor belt and place them in a cart. As you gain more experience, you will have the opportunity to perform a variety of tasks within the sorting center.

You will work the evening shift, which starts between 4:30 PM and 5:30 PM and ends at 1:00 AM.

Packages can weigh up to 25 kg. If a package is heavier, you will always lift it together with a colleague.

- You are available 2 or 3 days per week, on Monday, Tuesday and/or Wednesday
- You speak Dutch or English
- You are at least 18 years old
- You live in or around Zwolle, Meppel or Kampen
- You have your own transportation (car, bicycle or scooter) or live within walking distance of the sorting center
- You are able to lift packages weighing up to 25 kg
